create_Latent_model: create a Latent module with input/output linear layers and position embeddings for transformer models
use_Latent_to_input: use the Latent class to_input method to project input tokens and add position embeddings
use_Latent_to_output: use the Latent class to_output method to apply layer norm and project hidden states back
create_ShapePositionEmbedder: create a ShapePositionEmbedder that generates fixed 3D grid position embeddings from resolution and patch size
create_LearntPositionEmbedder: create a LearntPositionEmbedder that returns trainable random position embeddings for a given token length
